product_brief.brief_description: Formulate a clean label chocolate hazelnut spread containing at least 8% protein, at most 20% sugar, and smooth spreadability at room temperature. Requires roasted hazelnut and cocoa flavour, low oil separation, 12-month ambient shelf life, and cost under 11.0 USD/kg. Avoid dairy milk, whey, and palm oil.
